The technical specification of the pump SOLOVIC PUMP

This document is initiated by Hatem Abd El daim 
 , tested and revised by eng. Abdel Naser Taha , accepted by eng. Samy 
 Shehatah Ibrahim general manager, and 
 approved by eng. Abdel Naby Abdel Ghany head sector of High dam 
 Hydraulic power station and certified by eng. 
 Mohammed Osama Solima HPGC general director quality control .

items:
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category

Safety fence (rope) with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear the safety and healthy 
 protective equipment as safety shoes, helmet .... etc

Stop pump and switch off the 
 power supply

Close the out let and inlet 
 valves
Put suitable warning boards

Safety helmet and 
 safety shoes
Set of wrench
Alignment equipment
Grease for lubricating
Cleaning material
Check the alignment of the pump
Operate the pump to check the noise

Stop pump and switch off the power supply and close the out let and inlet 
 valves
Dismantle the coupling

Dismantle the shaft and impeller and protection and cooling pushing and check 
 for defects or craks
Check key and change if need
Check the bearing if need
Install the pump and alignment with motor
Install the coupling
Operate the pump and check the load current
